recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mechanically faithful browser-native endless runner/platformer called **Spinvolt Loop Rush**. The player selects a cartoon speed runner and races right through a portrait-first neon loopway. Preserve acceleration, friction, gravity, jumping, boost drain/recharge, platform collisions, AABB pickups/hazards, distance-plus-action score, rings-as-shield damage, enemy defeat when boosting or falling, chaos-core unlock thresholds, game-over when hit with no rings, and restart. Transform the presentation into a Sonic-inspired but original neon arcade world with loop rails, voltage rings, patrol bots, overdrive HUD, chaos cores, speed streaks, checker ground, mobile joystick, and large Jump/Boost buttons.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Canvas endless runner / platformer with acceleration, jumping, boosting, platforms, collectibles, and enemy contact.
- objective: Run right as long as possible, collect rings, defeat patrol enemies when attacking, and build distance score.
- input model: Keyboard arrows/WASD, Space jump, Shift boost; mobile virtual joystick plus Jump and Boost buttons.
- core loop: Start, select runner, accelerate through generated chunks, land on platforms, collect rings, spend/recharge boost, avoid or attack enemies, grow score by distance and pickups.
- fail/friction state: Damage with rings drops all rings and grants temporary invincibility; damage with zero rings ends the run and exposes restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve movement constants, acceleration/friction feel, gravity, jump impulse, boost drain/recharge, speed caps, camera follow, endless generation, AABB collision, ring scoring, enemy defeat/damage semantics, ring-loss shield, score display, chaos-core progression thresholds, and restart flow.

## Remixed target
Spinvolt Loop Rush reframes the same mechanic truth as a portrait-first neon arcade speedway: a rebellious blue Spinvolt Courier races across loop rails, collects voltage rings, bursts patrol bots, charges overdrive, unlocks chaos cores, and wipes out only when hit without rings. Presentation, HUD vocabulary, procedural art, background ownership, and mobile readability are rebuilt while mechanics remain faithful.

ranked_mechanics.reason: Momentum, rings, boost, mascot runner, and enemy stomp/boost contact are central.
Chunks generate indefinitely and score increases with distance.
Jumping, gravity, platforms, and landing collisions drive traversal.
Patrol bots punish unsafe contact and can end the run.
Voltage rings and distance determine score/progression.
